positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Design and implement ETL workflows between various data sources such as SAP, SQL Server, Oracle database and data warehouse using ETL Tools, WebFOCUS and SQL.
-  Develop an automate system to print lab samples’ barcode labels for multiple chemical manufacturing sites using Thermo Sample Manager LIMS VGL, ZPL, Window Services and Oracle PL/SQL. 
- Develop interface to generate new lab testing samples from in-house software using IBI iWay ETL Tools, Oracle PL/SQL, XML, and Web services.
- Design and develop a SaaS rail yard inventory system using C#, ASP.NET, Telerik, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL. This system provides railcar tracking, switching, and a complete historical record of all rail’s activities for manufacturers and ports in USA, Canada and Mexico.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained, planned, designed, developed and implemented web application software to manage surveillance cameras and systems using C# ASP.NET, XML, SQL, HTML/CSS, ActiveX, JavaScript, AJAX, Web Services.
- Integrated with Cisco video surveillance system’s databases to configure, manage and control cameras and users.
- Obtained requirements and successfully integrated with Aventura Video Management System for recording and distributing live video from analog and/or digital source.
- Integrated third party security products and systems.
- Trained and assisted customer service engineers.

positions.title: Programmer / Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Structured, developed and maintained an Assessment Database to measure student performance for multiple programs in School of Business using VBA, SQL and Microsoft Access.
- Developed, produced routine and generated reports to support assessment’s requirements.

positions.title: Intern Web Developer
positions.description:
- Researched, planned, designed, developed and administered Intel Intranet sites using Microsoft SharePoint, HTML, CSS and Javascript 
- Trained non-IT people to maintain the website content.

positions.title: Intern Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote Dynamic Link Library( DLL) in C# .NET to integrate OEM finger pulse oximeter and OEM cholesterol test system to a cardiovascular system. 
- Maintained, documented and improved legacy medical applications.
